title: 第一百七十四章 新枝第一百七十三章 迁坟
content_zh:
第一百七十四章新枝
一九八七年四月十三日，北京。长安街上的槐树刚冒了新芽。她站在台阶上，望着天安门广场上飘扬的五星红旗，深深地吸了一口气。下午四时整，中葡两国政府首脑在这里签署了《中华人民共和国政府和葡萄牙共和国政府关于澳门问题的联合声明》。继香港之后，澳门也确定了回归日期——一九九九年十二月二十日。她将作为外交部北美司副司长，在澳门回归过渡期承担中葡联络小组的部分协调工作。
回到办公室后，她拨通了广州的电话，向何成局报告了澳门回归的确切日期，并提及中葡联络小组的工作即将启动，她可能会频繁往返于北京、澳门和里斯本之间。
电话那头的何成局听完，沉默了一会儿。他想起了一九四九年在天安门观礼台上的那个下午，何家六十四口人淹没在三十万人的海洋里，他对何国说：“何家的船，从今天起，往北开。”如今三十八年过去，往北开的船已经到了北京，到了旧金山，到了伦敦。而南边的两颗明珠，一颗已经定下了归期，另一颗也终于排上了日程。他对着话筒说：“等你回来，去白云山看看你奶奶们。”
挂掉电话后，何成局走出书房。又到了桂花开放的时节，今年的花开得格外繁盛，金灿灿的花瓣落了满地，香气浓得像一缸打翻的陈酿。他在树下站了很久，用手掌轻轻拍了拍树干，然后转身走进茶室。何国已经在里面了，八十七岁的他头发全白了，泡茶的手依然很稳。
“国儿，今年是兔年。何家在兔年要做几件事。”何成局在藤椅上坐下，接过何国递来的茶杯。
何国点头，等祖父继续说下去。这四十年来，每一次家族会议上的部署都由祖父发起，而每一次部署都踩在了时代的节拍上。
“第一件，遮天集团的股权结构要按照香港回归的要求完成调整，在澳门回归之前就要全部到位。第二件，保护伞合资药厂已经投产三年了，下一步要扩大产品线，安神香只是个开始，何氏医馆的镇痛贴膏、抗炎喷雾都要跟上。第三件，太平洋矿业的稀土深加工项目要加快，不能只卖矿石，要往下游延伸，这件事让米远牵头。第四件——何铭的婚事，拖得够久了。”
何国一一记下，嘴角在听到最后一条时微微弯了弯。何铭今年已经四十出头，从航运板块到深圳工业园再到遮天集团，他一个人扛了太多事，婚事一拖再拖。是时候了。
一个月后，何铭的婚礼在广州何家老宅举行。婚礼从简，只邀请了何家五代人和少数至交。何铭穿着深蓝色中山装，新娘林静穿着红色旗袍，两人并肩站在正堂里，对着何成局和何家十六位先人的牌位鞠躬行礼。何成局坐在主位上，看着这对新人，难得地笑了一下。
婚礼过后，何心也带了个人回来。那是个戴眼镜的年轻工程师，姓钱，跟何心在同一个实验室工作，说话时会脸红。何心带他走进何家老宅时，何山正在院子里教徒弟打洪拳，虎形拳的拳风扫得桂花簌簌往下落。钱工程师站在旁边看了一会儿，何山收拳后朝他点了点头，转头对何心说了句“根基不错”。何心脸红了——她从小跟着何山练拳，知道父亲这句话的分量。
何成局在桂花树下单独见了钱工程师。没有考校武功，没有盘问家世，只是泡了一壶铁观音，聊了聊他在实验室里做什么。钱工程师起初有些紧张，后来慢慢放松下来，向老人解释了卫星材料的一些基本原理。何成局听完，微微点头，说了一句：“何家的女婿，不一定要会做生意。会做对国家有用的事，就够了。”钱工程师松了一口气，端起茶杯的手还在微微发抖。
何铭婚后不久，何成局将家族日常事务的处理交给了何国和何铭，开始逐渐将重心转入闭关。年近百岁的何国仍然硬朗，作为第四代的核心，他坐镇茶室，每日早晨烧水泡茶的习惯雷打不动，何铭则在正堂里处理集团事务。遇到拿不定主意的决策，何铭总会去茶室问何国，何国从不直接告诉他答案，只是在泡茶时不经意地提几个问题——这条航线你父亲当年跑过，他遇到过同样的情况，后来他选了绕道——何铭听完便明白了。何家五代人，每一代人都有自己的担子，但泡茶的手艺和做事的分寸，是一代一代传下来的。
何成局虽已半隐居，但家族大事从未旁落。他的天人境感知力能覆盖整座老宅乃至更远，何国每天泡茶时，都能感觉到祖父的“注视”从后院的桂花树下远远地投过来。那注视不是监视，而是一种沉静的、温厚的守护，就像那棵桂花树本身，不言不语，却一直站在那里。
何铭接掌集团后，在何国和何洋的辅佐下逐步推动了几项关键举措。遮天集团完成了面向香港回归的股权结构调整；保护伞制药的合资药厂扩大了产品线，何氏医馆的镇痛贴膏通过了FDA临床二期审批；太平洋矿业在温哥华建立了第一个海外稀土深加工实验室；南洋橡胶的种植园面积扩大了百分之三十，并开始进入可持续橡胶种植领域。与此同时，何家的第五代和第六代也在各行各业崭露头角。
何铭担任巨臂集团副总裁兼遮天中国有限公司总经理，全面主持集团的日常运营。他花了三年时间将祖父留下的战略蓝图逐项落地——合资药厂、稀土深加工、橡胶长期协议，每一项都在他手里变成了白纸黑字的合同和拔地而起的厂房。何国说他“比你曾祖父少了几分锋芒，多了几分稳当”，何铭只是笑了笑，继续低头批文件。
何米宁升任外交部北美司副司长，成为何家第五代中在体制内走得最远的人。她频繁往返于北京、华盛顿和澳门之间，在中葡联络小组的工作中承担了大量实质性谈判任务。保护伞制药在美国的几项新药审批，也是她在法律法规层面提供了关键支持。有人问她，何家的生意做到美国去了，她在外交部工作会不会有利益冲突。她回答得很干脆：“何家在美国卖的是合法合规的中国药，我替国家争取的是公平对等的贸易规则——这两件事，从来都是一件事。”
第一百七十四章新枝
何米瑞在酒泉卫星发射中心一待就是十几年。从东方红一号的改进型号到新型运载火箭，他参与过的发射任务不下二十次。他结过一次婚，妻子是酒泉基地的气象工程师，两人在戈壁滩上相识相恋，有一个儿子，小名叫石头，被何岩接到广州读书。有人问他后不后悔把青春扔在戈壁滩上，他想了想说：“我小时候在曾祖父书房里看到一幅画，画的是虎门炮台。曾祖父告诉我，当年英国人打进来的时候，清军的炮打在他们的铁甲舰上，连个坑都砸不出来。我想让这个国家的下一代人不用再听这种故事。”
何心毕业后留在北航任教，在航天材料领域发表了多篇高质量论文，她的通感体质让她在材料微观结构的感知上有远超常人的直觉，百宝体又让她能快速掌握跨学科知识。何成局说她“替何家站在了最前沿”。何心每次回广州都会去何芳的工作间坐一会儿，用她新学的技术做几炉安神香，放在何芳的牌位前。何米彩每次看到她做香的手法都会感叹：“你的手比你芳姑婆还稳。”何心摇头：“芳姑婆六十年才练出来的功夫，我才哪到哪。”

何米远负责科技投资板块，在生物医药和新材料两个领域投出了几家独角兽企业，投资眼光被业内称为“何家最毒的眼睛”。三十二岁那年，他带着团队去温哥华为太平洋矿业的稀土深加工实验室选址，在零下二十度的风雪里跑了三个城市，最后在温哥华郊区拿下一栋旧实验楼，改造成了太平洋矿业海外研发中心。何峰听说后，在电话里对他说：“何家的男人，在哪里都能扎根。”
何米安在宝芝林跟着何山教拳，兼管何家武馆的日常运营。何山退休后，梁铮也年事渐高，宝芝林的实际掌门人之责开始向何米安过渡。他从小沉默寡言，教拳时话也不多，但弟子们都服他——因为他的手底下有真功夫，洪拳的虎形拳在他手里打出来，虎啸声能让院子里的树叶簌簌往下落。
还有第六代。何铭和林静的长子何嘉树已经上小学了，从小就显示出极强的算学天赋，何海把自己的算盘送给了他，何嘉树抱着算盘在桂花树下拨了一整个暑假，何成局远远看着，对何国说了一句：“这孩子像海弟。”何米瑞的儿子何石头在酒泉基地的子弟学校念书，寒暑假回广州时总是缠着何米远问各种机械原理，何米远给他买了一整套物理实验器材。何米彩与丈夫、广州中医药大学附属医院的内科医生陈志远生了一个女儿，取名陈怀芷，三岁就能在何氏医馆的药材柜前站一整个下午，挨个闻药材，何米彩看得眼眶发热，对陈志远说：“这孩子跟我芳姑婆一样，有通感。”
何成局闭关的时间越来越长。以前他每天只打坐两个时辰，其余时间在茶室里喝茶、听汇报、逗弄第六代的小孩。现在他常常一闭关就是三五天，甚至一周，只在桂花树下静坐，周身被一层极淡的黄色光晕笼罩，那是天人境真气外放的征兆。何岩每隔几天来给他请一次脉，每次都得出同样的结论：一切平稳，不是衰弱，是沉淀。何岩自己对何国说，祖父把天人境的真气收进丹田里，运转的速度比年轻时慢了，但更稳了，像是珠江到了入海口，江面宽了，流速慢了，但水深了不知多少倍。
何国知道这意味着什么。天人境的修为正在从“盛”转入“藏”，这是长寿武者进入最后阶段的征兆——不是灯油耗尽，而是功力内敛，为最终那一关做准备。他没有问，也没有劝，只是每天照常给祖父泡一壶铁观音，放在桂花树下的石桌上。有时候祖父出关，茶还是热的；有时候茶凉了，他就换一壶新的。何心从北京回来后，每天换茶的任务就落到了她头上。她换好茶后会坐在旁边的石凳上看书，或者闭上眼睛练习用通感体质感知祖父丹田里那股浑厚而缓慢的真气波动。她总觉得那波动像潮汐——不是珠江口的潮汐，是更广阔、更遥远的一种潮汐，仿佛是从地心深处涌上来的，又好像是宇宙中某种遥远天体的引力在这里引发的回响。
何成局知道自己的身体在走向最后的阶段。天人境给他的三百年寿元还剩下一百多年，但他不打算用完。他活了一百八十八年，见证了一个国家从跪着到站着的全过程。他相信那个时刻会来得恰到好处——不是太早，也不是太晚，就像珠江口的潮汐，涨潮和退潮都有它的时辰。
一天，何铭带着刚上小学的儿子何嘉树在桂花树下读书，何嘉树忽然仰头问何成局：“高祖父，我们老师上课的时候讲，中国现在有***、有氢弹、有卫星、有特区，香港和澳门也要回来了。我们还有什么没有的？”
何铭刚想替儿子道歉，何成局摆了摆手，低头看着何嘉树的眼睛。那双眼睛干净得像是刚从珠江里舀上来的一瓢清水。他在那双眼睛里看到了何安的影子，看到了何辩的影子，看到了何芳的影子，看到了何甘的影子，看到了所有来过又走了的人。
他伸手摸了摸何嘉树的头，说了一句十岁孩子能听懂的话。
“我们还没有一艘能在月亮上靠岸的船。”
何嘉树眨了眨眼睛，似懂非懂。何铭在旁边听着，默默把这句话记在了心里。他知道祖父从来不说废话——当年说“何家的船往北开”，后来往北开了四十年；说“何家要有自己的技术班底”，后来保护伞和太平洋矿业都有了自主研发能力；说“何家的坟要迁回来”，后来十六座坟都迁回了白云山。现在祖父说“我们还没有一艘能在月亮上靠岸的船”，那这句话，大概也会在未来的某一天实现。

Chapter 174 New Branches
April 13, 1987, Beijing. The locust trees on Chang'an Street have just sprouted new buds. She stood on the steps, looked at the five-star red flag flying in Tiananmen Square, and took a deep breath. At 4 o'clock in the afternoon, the heads of government of China and Portugal signed the "Joint Statement on the Macao Issue between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Portuguese Republic" here. Following Hong Kong, Macau also determined the return date - December 20, 1999. As deputy director-general of the North American Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, she will be responsible for part of the coordination work of the Sino-Portuguese Liaison Group during the transitional period of Macao's return to China.
After returning to the office, she dialed the number in Guangzhou and reported to He Chengju the exact date of Macau's return. She also mentioned that the work of the Sino-Portuguese Liaison Group was about to start and that she might frequently travel between Beijing, Macau and Lisbon.
He Chengju on the other end of the phone was silent for a while after listening. He recalled that afternoon in 1949 on the Tiananmen viewing platform, when sixty-four members of the He family were drowned in a sea of ​​300,000 people. He said to He Guo: "The He family's ship will sail north from today on." Now, thirty-eight years later, the ship sailing north has arrived in Beijing, San Francisco, and London. As for the two pearls in the south, one has already set a return date, and the other has finally been scheduled. He said into the microphone: "When you come back, go to Baiyun Mountain to see your grandmothers."
After hanging up the phone, He Chengju walked out of the study. It's the time when sweet-scented osmanthus blooms again, and this year's flowers are blooming particularly prosperously. The golden petals fall all over the ground, and the fragrance is as strong as a jar of spilled aged wine. He stood under the tree for a long time, patted the trunk lightly with his palm, then turned and walked into the tea room. He Guo is already inside. At the age of eighty-seven, his hair is completely white, and his hand for making tea is still very steady.
"Guo'er, this year is the Year of the Rabbit. The He family has to do a few things in the Year of the Rabbit." He Chengju sat down on the wicker chair and took the tea cup from He Guo.
He Guo nodded and waited for his grandfather to continue. In the past forty years, every deployment at a family meeting was initiated by my grandfather, and every deployment followed the beat of the times.
"The first thing is that the ownership structure of Zhetian Group must be adjusted in accordance with the requirements of Hong Kong's return, and it must be in place before Macau's return. The second thing is that the umbrella joint venture pharmaceutical factory has been in production for three years. The next step is to expand the product line. Anshenxiang is just the beginning. The analgesic plasters and anti-inflammatory sprays of He's Medical Center must be kept up. The third thing is that Pacific Mining's rare earth deep processing project must not only sell ore, but also extend downstream. The fourth thing - He Ming's marriage, has been delayed for long enough."
He Guo wrote them down one by one, and the corners of his mouth curved slightly when he heard the last one. He Ming is in his early forties this year. From the shipping sector to the Shenzhen Industrial Park to the Zhetian Group, he has shouldered too many things on his own, and his marriage has been delayed again and again. It's time.
A month later, He Ming's wedding was held at the old residence of the He family in Guangzhou. The wedding was simple, and only five generations of the He family and a few close friends were invited. He Ming was wearing a dark blue Chinese tunic suit, and the bride Lin Jing was wearing a red cheongsam. They stood side by side in the main hall, bowing to the tablets of He Chengju and the sixteen ancestors of the He family. He Chengju sat in the main seat, looked at the newlyweds, and gave a rare smile.
After the wedding, He Xin also brought someone back. It was a young engineer wearing glasses, his surname was Qian, who worked in the same laboratory as He Xin, and would blush when he spoke. When He Xin took him into the old house of the He family, He Shan was teaching his disciples how to do Hong Quan in the yard. The wind of the tiger-shaped fist swept the sweet-scented osmanthus down. Engineer Qian stood aside and watched for a while. He Shan nodded to him after withdrawing his fist, turned to He Xin and said, "The foundation is good." He Xin blushed - she had practiced boxing with He Shan since she was a child and knew the weight of her father's words.
He Chengju met Engineer Qian alone under the osmanthus tree. There is no martial arts test, no cross-examinationFamily background, just brewing a pot of Tieguanyin and chatting about what he was doing in the laboratory. Engineer Qian was a little nervous at first, but then slowly relaxed and explained some basic principles of satellite materials to the old man. After hearing this, He Chengju nodded slightly and said: "The son-in-law of the He family does not necessarily need to be able to do business. It is enough that he can do things useful to the country." Engineer Qian breathed a sigh of relief, and his hand still shook slightly when he picked up the tea cup.
Shortly after He Ming's marriage, He Chengju handed over the handling of the family's daily affairs to He Guo and He Ming, and began to gradually shift his focus to seclusion. He Guo, who is nearly a hundred years old, is still strong. As the core of the fourth generation, he sits in the teahouse and has the habit of boiling water to make tea every morning. He Ming handles group affairs in the main hall. When faced with an uncertain decision, He Ming would always go to the tearoom and ask He Guo. He Guo never told him the answer directly, but casually asked a few questions while making tea - your father ran this route back then, and he encountered the same situation, but later he chose a detour - He Ming understood after hearing this. There are five generations of the He family, and each generation has its own responsibilities, but the skill of making tea and the propriety of doing things are passed down from generation to generation.
Although He Chengju has been semi-reclusive, family affairs have never been neglected. His perception of the realm of heaven and man can cover the entire old house and even further. When He Guo makes tea every day, he can feel his grandfather's "gaze" from a distance under the osmanthus tree in the backyard. That gaze is not surveillance, but a kind of quiet and gentle protection, just like the sweet-scented osmanthus tree itself, silent but always standing there.
After He Ming took over the group, he gradually promoted several key initiatives with the assistance of He Guo and He Yang. Zhetian Group has completed the adjustment of its ownership structure for the return of Hong Kong; Umbrella Pharmaceuticals' joint venture pharmaceutical factory has expanded its product line, and Ho's Medical Center's analgesic patch has passed the second phase of FDA clinical approval; Pacific Mining has established the first overseas rare earth deep processing laboratory in Vancouver; Nanyang Rubber has expanded its plantation area by 30% and begun to enter the field of sustainable rubber planting. At the same time, the fifth and sixth generations of the He family are also making their mark in various walks of life.
He Ming serves as the vice president of Juji Group and general manager of Zhetian China Co., Ltd., fully presiding over the daily operations of the group. He spent three years implementing the strategic blueprint left by his grandfather one by one - joint venture pharmaceutical factory, rare earth deep processing, long-term rubber agreement, each of which was turned into a black-and-white contract and a factory building in his hands. He Guo said that he was "a little less sharp and a little more stable than your great-grandfather." He Ming just smiled and continued to approve documents with his head down.
He Mining was promoted to deputy director of the North American Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, becoming the fifth generation of the He family who has gone farthest within the system. She frequently travels between Beijing, Washington and Macau, and undertakes a large number of substantive negotiation tasks in the work of the China-Portugal Contact Group. She also provided critical support at the legal and regulatory level for Umbrella Pharmaceuticals' several new drug approvals in the United States. Someone asked her if it would be a conflict of interest for her to work in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs since the He family's business was in the United States.
